id-20261029-news-2.title: Frequent Cabinet Reshuffles and Policy Certainty: Why the Business Community Remains Cautious in Assessing the Political Climate

segments.src: Survei ICCI Kontan edisi Oktober 2026 mencatat Indeks Politik Nasional di level 2,89.
segments.tr: The October 2026 edition of the Kontan ICCI Survey recorded the National Political Index at the level of 2.89.

segments.src: Angka ini berada di bawah garis netral, dan posisi tersebut bertahan selama tiga kuartal berturut-turut.
segments.tr: This figure is below the neutral line, and this position has persisted for three consecutive quarters.

segments.src: Bagi pelaku usaha, hasil ini bukan sekadar statistik.
segments.tr: For business actors, this result is not merely a statistic.

segments.src: Ia mencerminkan cara dunia usaha membaca arah kebijakan, stabilitas pengambilan keputusan, dan seberapa jauh aturan main dapat dijadikan pegangan.
segments.tr: It reflects how the business world reads policy directions, decision-making stability, and the extent to which the rules of the game can be used as a guide.

segments.src: Tulisan ini membahas mengapa pergantian menteri dan konsistensi regulasi sering muncul dalam percakapan pengusaha, serta bagaimana kedua faktor itu dapat memengaruhi keputusan investasi dan ekspansi.
segments.tr: This article discusses why ministerial changes and regulatory consistency frequently appear in business conversations, and how these two factors can influence investment and expansion decisions.

segments.src: Pembahasan bersifat analitis dan tidak menilai pihak tertentu.
segments.tr: The discussion is analytical and does not judge any specific party.

segments.src: ## Apa yang dimaksud dengan indeks di bawah garis netral
segments.tr: ## What is meant by an index below the neutral line

segments.src: Indeks persepsi seperti ini disusun dari penilaian responden, umumnya kalangan pelaku usaha dan pengamat, terhadap kondisi politik.
segments.tr: Perception indices like this are compiled from the assessments of respondents, generally business actors and observers, regarding political conditions.

segments.src: Nilai di atas garis netral menandakan penilaian yang cenderung positif, sedangkan nilai di bawahnya menandakan sikap yang lebih hati-hati.
segments.tr: Values above the neutral line indicate a tendency toward a positive assessment, while values below it indicate a more cautious stance.

segments.src: Hal yang patut dicermati adalah durasinya.
segments.tr: A point worth noting is the duration.

segments.src: Satu kuartal di bawah garis netral dapat dipicu peristiwa sesaat.
segments.tr: A single quarter below the neutral line can be triggered by momentary events.

segments.src: Tiga kuartal berturut-turut menunjukkan kehati-hatian yang lebih menetap, sehingga lebih mungkin berkaitan dengan faktor struktural seperti kejelasan arah kebijakan.
segments.tr: Three consecutive quarters indicate a more persistent caution, making it more likely related to structural factors such as the clarity of policy direction.

segments.src: Perlu diingat pula bahwa indeks ini mengukur persepsi, bukan data kinerja ekonomi.
segments.tr: It should also be remembered that this index measures perception, not economic performance data.

segments.src: Persepsi tetap penting karena keputusan bisnis banyak dipengaruhi oleh ekspektasi.
segments.tr: Perception remains important because business decisions are heavily influenced by expectations.

segments.src: ## Reshuffle kabinet dari sudut pandang dunia usaha
segments.tr: ## Cabinet reshuffles from the perspective of the business world

segments.src: Perombakan kabinet adalah hak prerogatif presiden dan bisa dilakukan untuk berbagai alasan yang sah, misalnya penyegaran kinerja atau penyesuaian prioritas pemerintah.
segments.tr: Cabinet reshuffles are the prerogative of the president and can be carried out for various legitimate reasons, such as performance refreshment or adjustments to government priorities.

segments.src: Namun, dari sisi pelaku usaha, frekuensi pergantian membawa beberapa konsekuensi praktis:
segments.tr: However, from the perspective of business actors, the frequency of changes brings several practical consequences:

segments.src: - **Kesinambungan program.** Program yang sedang berjalan bisa ditinjau ulang oleh pejabat baru, sehingga jadwal dan prioritasnya berubah.
segments.tr: - **Program continuity.** Ongoing programs can be reviewed by new officials, changing their schedules and priorities.

segments.src: - **Hubungan kerja dengan regulator.** Komunikasi dan kesepahaman yang sudah terbangun dengan kementerian tertentu perlu dibangun kembali.
segments.tr: - **Working relationships with regulators.** Communication and understanding already built with certain ministries need to be rebuilt.

segments.src: - **Interpretasi aturan.** Peraturan pelaksana, surat edaran, atau praktik perizinan dapat berubah mengikuti pandangan pimpinan baru.
segments.tr: - **Rule interpretation.** Implementing regulations, circular letters, or licensing practices can change following the views of new leadership.

segments.src: - **Sinyal arah kebijakan.** Pergantian yang berulang dapat dibaca sebagai tanda arah belum sepenuhnya mantap, meskipun tidak selalu demikian.
segments.tr: - **Policy direction signals.** Repeated changes can be read as a sign that the direction is not yet fully settled, although this is not always the case.

segments.src: ## Kepastian kebijakan sebagai pertimbangan utama investasi
segments.tr: ## Policy certainty as a primary investment consideration

segments.src: Investor, baik domestik maupun asing, menimbang banyak hal: ukuran pasar, biaya, tenaga kerja, infrastruktur, dan risiko.
segments.tr: Investors, both domestic and foreign, weigh many things: market size, costs, labor, infrastructure, and risks.

segments.src: Di antara semuanya, kepastian kebijakan sering menjadi faktor penentu karena memengaruhi perhitungan jangka panjang.
segments.tr: Among them all, policy certainty often becomes a determining factor because it affects long-term calculations.

segments.src: Proyek manufaktur, energi, properti, atau logistik umumnya membutuhkan horizon pengembalian bertahun-tahun.
segments.tr: Manufacturing, energy, property, or logistics projects generally require a return horizon of many years.

segments.src: Jika aturan terkait perizinan, insentif pajak, kandungan lokal, atau tata niaga dapat berubah di tengah jalan, perusahaan cenderung menambahkan margin risiko pada hitungannya.
segments.tr: If rules related to licensing, tax incentives, local content, or trade arrangements can change midway, companies tend to add a risk margin to their calculations.

segments.src: Akibatnya, sebagian proyek yang semula layak dapat ditunda atau dikurangi skalanya.
segments.tr: As a result, some projects that were initially viable may be delayed or scaled down.

segments.src: Dengan kata lain, dunia usaha tidak selalu menolak aturan yang ketat.
segments.tr: In other words, the business world does not always reject strict rules.

segments.src: Yang lebih dicari adalah aturan yang jelas, dapat diprediksi, dan diterapkan secara konsisten.
segments.tr: What is sought instead are rules that are clear, predictable, and applied consistently.

segments.src: ## Dampak pada keputusan ekspansi
segments.tr: ## Impact on expansion decisions

segments.src: Di tingkat perusahaan, sikap hati-hati biasanya tampak dalam beberapa bentuk:
segments.tr: At the corporate level, a cautious attitude usually appears in several forms:

segments.src: 1. **Menunda belanja modal** sampai ada kejelasan regulasi.
segments.tr: 1. **Delaying capital expenditure** until there is regulatory clarity.

segments.src: 2. **Memilih ekspansi bertahap** dibandingkan komitmen besar sekaligus.
segments.tr: 2. **Choosing gradual expansion** compared to large commitments all at once.

segments.src: 3. **Menjaga likuiditas lebih tebal** sebagai penyangga ketidakpastian.
segments.tr: 3. **Maintaining thicker liquidity** as a buffer against uncertainty.

segments.src: 4. **Memprioritaskan efisiensi** daripada penambahan kapasitas.
segments.tr: 4. **Prioritizing efficiency** rather than capacity additions.

segments.src: 5. **Menunggu momentum** sebelum merekrut atau meluncurkan lini produk baru.
segments.tr: 5. **Waiting for momentum** before hiring or launching new product lines.

segments.src: Bagi usaha kecil dan menengah, dampaknya bisa berbeda.
segments.tr: For small and medium enterprises, the impact can be different.

segments.src: UMKM biasanya tidak menggantungkan keputusan pada satu regulasi besar, tetapi tetap merasakan efek tidak langsung, seperti perubahan permintaan, harga bahan baku, atau prosedur perizinan.
segments.tr: MSMEs usually do not hinge decisions on a single major regulation, but still feel indirect effects, such as changes in demand, raw material prices, or licensing procedures.

segments.src: ## Apa yang bisa memperbaiki persepsi
segments.tr: ## What can improve perceptions

segments.src: Beberapa langkah yang kerap diusulkan kalangan pengamat dan asosiasi usaha antara lain:
segments.tr: Some steps frequently proposed by observers and business associations include:

segments.src: - **Konsultasi publik yang memadai** sebelum aturan penting diterbitkan.
segments.tr: - **Adequate public consultation** before important rules are issued.

segments.src: - **Masa transisi yang jelas** ketika ada perubahan regulasi.
segments.tr: - **Clear transition periods** when regulatory changes occur.

segments.src: - **Penyederhanaan dan harmonisasi aturan** lintas kementerian dan antara pusat dan daerah.
segments.tr: - **Simplification and harmonization of rules** across ministries and between the central and regional governments.

segments.src: - **Komunikasi kebijakan yang konsisten** agar pasar tidak menafsirkan sinyal secara berbeda-beda.
segments.tr: - **Consistent policy communication** so the market does not interpret signals differently.

segments.src: - **Kesinambungan program prioritas** meskipun terjadi pergantian pejabat.
segments.tr: - **Continuity of priority programs** even when official changes happen.

segments.src: Langkah-langkah ini tidak berarti membatasi ruang pemerintah untuk mengambil keputusan.
segments.tr: These steps do not mean limiting the government's room to make decisions.

segments.src: Tujuannya adalah mengurangi ketidakpastian yang tidak perlu.
segments.tr: The goal is to reduce unnecessary uncertainty.

segments.src: ## Cara membaca hasil survei dengan proporsional
segments.tr: ## How to read survey results proportionally

segments.src: Beberapa catatan agar angka 2,89 dipahami secara seimbang:
segments.tr: Some notes so that the 2.89 figure is understood in a balanced way:

segments.src: - Survei persepsi memiliki keterbatasan metodologis, seperti jumlah dan latar belakang responden.
segments.tr: - Perception surveys have methodological limitations, such as the number and background of respondents.

segments.src: - Indeks politik hanya satu dari banyak indikator. Investasi juga dipengaruhi suku bunga, nilai tukar, kondisi global, dan permintaan domestik.
segments.tr: - The political index is only one of many indicators. Investment is also influenced by interest rates, exchange rates, global conditions, and domestic demand.

segments.src: - Nilai di bawah garis netral menunjukkan kehati-hatian, bukan otomatis pesimisme total atau berhentinya aktivitas usaha.
segments.tr: - Values below the neutral line indicate caution, not automatically total pessimism or the cessation of business activity.

segments.src: - Persepsi dapat berubah bila ada langkah nyata yang memperkuat kepastian.
segments.tr: - Perceptions can change if there are real steps that strengthen certainty.

segments.src: ## Penutup
segments.tr: ## Conclusion

segments.src: Indeks Politik Nasional 2,89 dalam survei ICCI Kontan Oktober 2026 menggambarkan dunia usaha yang masih menunggu kejelasan.
segments.tr: The National Political Index of 2.89 in the October 2026 Kontan survey depicts a business world that is still waiting for clarity.

segments.src: Pergantian menteri yang berulang dan konsistensi aturan menjadi dua faktor yang sering dikaitkan dengan sikap tersebut, karena keduanya menyentuh hal yang paling dibutuhkan investor: kemampuan memperkirakan masa depan.
segments.tr: Repeated ministerial changes and rule consistency become two factors often associated with this attitude, because both touch upon what investors need most: the ability to forecast the future.

segments.src: Bagi pembaca yang menjalankan usaha, memantau perkembangan regulasi, menyiapkan skenario, dan menjaga fleksibilitas keuangan adalah langkah yang masuk akal.
segments.tr: For readers running businesses, monitoring regulatory developments, preparing scenarios, and maintaining financial flexibility are sensible steps.

segments.src: Sementara itu, perkembangan indeks pada kuartal-kuartal berikutnya akan menunjukkan apakah kehati-hatian ini mereda atau berlanjut.
segments.tr: Meanwhile, the development of the index in subsequent quarters will show whether this caution subsides or continues.

segments.src: *Catatan: Artikel ini bersifat informasi umum dan bukan nasihat investasi atau hukum.
segments.tr: *Note: This article is of general information and not investment or legal advice.

segments.src: Untuk keputusan bisnis tertentu, rujuklah data resmi dan konsultasikan dengan profesional yang berkompeten.*
segments.tr: For specific business decisions, refer to official data and consult with competent professionals.*

id-20261029-news-3.title: Danantara and SOE Management: What the Public Needs to Monitor Regarding Governance, Transparency, and State Fund Risks

segments.src: Badan Pengelola Investasi Daya Anagata Nusantara, atau Danantara, dibentuk untuk mengelola aset dan investasi badan usaha milik negara (BUMN) secara terkonsolidasi.
segments.tr: The Daya Anagata Nusantara Investment Management Agency, or Danantara, was established to manage the assets and investments of state-owned enterprises (SOEs) in a consolidated manner.

segments.src: Skalanya besar, sehingga pertanyaan tentang cara kerja, pengawasan, dan keterbukaannya menyangkut kepentingan banyak orang.
segments.tr: Its scale is significant, so questions about its operations, oversight, and openness concern many people.

segments.src: Artikel ini bersifat informatif dan netral.
segments.tr: This article is informative and neutral.

segments.src: Tujuannya membantu pembaca memahami kerangka dasarnya dan menyiapkan alat sederhana untuk menilai investasi yang memakai dana publik.
segments.tr: Its purpose is to help readers understand the basic framework and prepare simple tools to assess investments that use public funds.

segments.src: > Catatan: aturan dan struktur Danantara dapat berubah seiring revisi regulasi dan kebijakan turunan. Periksa selalu sumber resmi pemerintah, peraturan terbaru, dan laporan lembaga pengawas sebelum mengambil kesimpulan.
segments.tr: > Note: Danantara's rules and structure may change as regulations and derivative policies are revised. Always check official government sources, the latest regulations, and reports from oversight bodies before drawing conclusions.

segments.src: ## Apa itu Danantara dan mengapa penting?
segments.tr: ## What is Danantara and why is it important?

segments.src: Danantara diperkenalkan pemerintah pada awal 2025 sebagai lembaga pengelola investasi yang menaungi sejumlah BUMN besar.
segments.tr: Danantara was introduced by the government in early 2025 as an investment management agency that oversees a number of major SOEs.

segments.src: Gagasan utamanya adalah mengonsolidasikan aset dan dividen BUMN agar dapat dikelola lebih terpusat, dengan harapan mendorong investasi di sektor-sektor strategis.
segments.tr: The main idea is to consolidate SOE assets and dividends so they can be managed more centrally, with the hope of boosting investment in strategic sectors.

segments.src: Model serupa ada di sejumlah negara, yang biasa disebut dana kekayaan negara (sovereign wealth fund).
segments.tr: Similar models exist in a number of countries, commonly referred to as sovereign wealth funds.

segments.src: Alasan publik perlu memperhatikannya sederhana.
segments.tr: The reason the public needs to pay attention is simple.

segments.src: BUMN dimiliki negara, dan negara dibiayai oleh pajak, penerimaan negara bukan pajak, serta kekayaan alam.
segments.tr: SOEs are owned by the state, and the state is financed by taxes, non-tax state revenue, and natural resources.

segments.src: Keputusan investasi di lembaga sebesar ini bisa berdampak pada layanan publik, lapangan kerja, harga barang dan jasa, serta kondisi keuangan negara dalam jangka panjang.
segments.tr: Investment decisions in an agency of this size can impact public services, employment, the prices of goods and services, and the state's financial condition in the long term.

segments.src: ## Bagaimana cara kerjanya secara umum?
segments.tr: ## How does it work in general?

segments.src: Secara garis besar, struktur lembaga semacam ini memiliki beberapa lapisan:
segments.tr: Broadly speaking, the structure of such an agency has several layers:

segments.src: - **Badan pengelola utama**: menetapkan arah strategis, kebijakan investasi, dan tata kelola.
segments.tr: - **Main management body**: sets strategic direction, investment policies, and governance.

segments.src: - **Entitas operasional**: biasanya terpisah untuk fungsi pengelolaan aset dan fungsi investasi, agar peran dan tanggung jawabnya jelas.
segments.tr: - **Operational entities**: usually separated for asset management functions and investment functions, so that roles and responsibilities are clear.

segments.src: - **BUMN dan anak usaha**: perusahaan yang tetap menjalankan bisnis sehari-hari, seperti perbankan, energi, telekomunikasi, dan infrastruktur.
segments.tr: - **SOEs and subsidiaries**: companies that continue to run day-to-day business, such as banking, energy, telecommunications, and infrastructure.

segments.src: - **Mitra investasi**: investor domestik atau asing yang dapat bekerja sama dalam proyek tertentu.
segments.tr: - **Investment partners**: domestic or foreign investors who can collaborate on specific projects.

segments.src: Sumber dana dan imbal hasilnya umumnya berasal dari dividen BUMN, hasil pengelolaan aset, serta kemitraan investasi.
segments.tr: Sources of funds and their returns generally come from SOE dividends, asset management results, and investment partnerships.

segments.src: Detail struktur resmi sebaiknya dibaca langsung pada undang-undang BUMN beserta perubahannya, peraturan pemerintah, dan situs resmi lembaga.
segments.tr: Details of the official structure should be read directly in the SOE law and its amendments, government regulations, and the agency's official website.

segments.src: ## Siapa yang mengawasi?
segments.tr: ## Who provides oversight?

segments.src: Pengawasan pada lembaga publik biasanya berlapis.
segments.tr: Oversight of public agencies is usually layered.

segments.src: Warga dapat mengenali pihak-pihak berikut:
segments.tr: Citizens can identify the following parties:

segments.src: 1. **Dewan pengawas dan komisaris**: pengawasan internal atas kebijakan dan kinerja manajemen.
segments.tr: 1. **Supervisory board and commissioners**: internal oversight of management policies and performance.

segments.src: 2. **Auditor independen**: audit laporan keuangan tahunan oleh kantor akuntan publik.
segments.tr: 2. **Independent auditors**: annual financial statement audits by public accounting firms.

segments.src: 3. **Badan Pemeriksa Keuangan (BPK)**: memeriksa pengelolaan keuangan negara. Cakupan kewenangan pemeriksaan terhadap entitas seperti Danantara menjadi pokok pembahasan para ahli, sehingga perlu dicek ketentuan terbaru.
segments.tr: 3. **Audit Board of Indonesia (BPK)**: examines the management of state finances. The scope of audit authority over entities like Danantara is a subject of discussion among experts, so the latest provisions need to be checked.

segments.src: 4. **Lembaga penegak hukum dan antikorupsi**: KPK, kejaksaan, dan kepolisian bekerja bila ada dugaan pelanggaran hukum.
segments.tr: 4. **Law enforcement and anti-corruption agencies**: the KPK, the Attorney General's Office, and the police work if there are allegations of legal violations.

segments.src: 5. **DPR**: fungsi pengawasan politik, termasuk rapat dengar pendapat dan pembahasan anggaran.
segments.tr: 5. **DPR (House of Representatives)**: political oversight function, including hearings and budget discussions.

segments.src: 6. **Otoritas sektor**: misalnya OJK dan otoritas bursa untuk perusahaan yang tercatat di pasar modal.
segments.tr: 6. **Sectoral authorities**: for example, the OJK (Financial Services Authority) and stock exchange authorities for companies listed on the capital market.

segments.src: 7. **Publik, media, dan masyarakat sipil**: pengawasan melalui akses informasi, pemberitaan, dan kajian independen.
segments.tr: 7. **Public, media, and civil society**: oversight through access to information, news coverage, and independent studies.

segments.src: Pertanyaan yang sering muncul dalam diskusi publik: apakah kerugian investasi dapat dikategorikan sebagai kerugian negara, bagaimana prinsip *business judgment rule* diterapkan, dan sejauh mana pemeriksaan eksternal dapat menjangkau.
segments.tr: Questions that often arise in public discussion: can investment losses be categorized as state losses, how is the *business judgment rule* applied, and to what extent can external examinations reach.

segments.src: Pembaca disarankan mengikuti penjelasan resmi dan analisis ahli hukum yang kredibel, bukan potongan opini di media sosial.
segments.tr: Readers are advised to follow official explanations and analyses from credible legal experts, not snippets of opinions on social media.

segments.src: ## Indikator transparansi yang bisa dipakai warga
segments.tr: ## Transparency indicators that citizens can use

segments.src: Anda tidak perlu menjadi analis keuangan untuk menilai keterbukaan sebuah lembaga.
segments.tr: You don't need to be a financial analyst to assess the openness of an agency.

segments.src: Berikut daftar periksa praktis:
segments.tr: Here is a practical checklist:

segments.src: - **Laporan tahunan dan laporan keuangan teraudit** yang dipublikasikan tepat waktu dan mudah diunduh.
segments.tr: - **Annual reports and audited financial statements** that are published on time and easy to download.

segments.src: - **Opini auditor**: apakah wajar tanpa pengecualian, dan adakah catatan penting dari auditor.
segments.tr: - **Auditor's opinion**: whether it is unqualified, and whether there are important notes from the auditor.

segments.src: - **Kebijakan investasi tertulis**: sektor yang disasar, batas risiko, dan kriteria pemilihan proyek.
segments.tr: - **Written investment policy**: targeted sectors, risk limits, and project selection criteria.

segments.src: - **Daftar investasi utama**: nilai, mitra, dan status proyek, sejauh tidak mengganggu kerahasiaan komersial yang sah.
segments.tr: - **List of major investments**: value, partners, and project status, as long as it does not interfere with legitimate commercial confidentiality.

segments.src: - **Pengelolaan konflik kepentingan**: aturan benturan kepentingan, rangkap jabatan, dan pelaporan harta kekayaan pejabat.
segments.tr: - **Conflict of interest management**: rules on conflicts of interest, concurrent positions, and reporting of officials' wealth.

segments.src: - **Proses pengangkatan pimpinan**: kriteria, rekam jejak, dan mekanisme seleksi yang jelas.
segments.tr: - **Leadership appointment process**: clear criteria, track record, and selection mechanisms.

segments.src: - **Indikator kinerja**: imbal hasil, rasio utang, dan realisasi dibanding target.
segments.tr: - **Performance indicators**: returns, debt ratios, and realization compared to targets.

segments.src: - **Saluran pengaduan**: mekanisme whistleblowing dan tindak lanjutnya.
segments.tr: - **Complaint channels**: whistleblowing mechanisms and their follow-up.

segments.src: - **Akses informasi publik**: kesediaan menjawab permohonan sesuai Undang-Undang Keterbukaan Informasi Publik.
segments.tr: - **Public information access**: willingness to respond to requests in accordance with the Public Information Disclosure Law.

segments.src: ## Risiko dana negara yang perlu dicermati
segments.tr: ## State fund risks to watch out for

segments.src: Setiap investasi mengandung risiko.
segments.tr: Every investment carries risk.

segments.src: Yang perlu dilihat adalah apakah risiko itu dikenali, diukur, dan diungkapkan.
segments.tr: What needs to be seen is whether that risk is identified, measured, and disclosed.

segments.src: Beberapa area yang lazim diperhatikan:
segments.tr: Some areas commonly observed:

segments.src: - **Risiko konsentrasi**: dana terlalu terpusat pada satu sektor atau proyek.
segments.tr: - **Concentration risk**: funds are too concentrated in one sector or project.

segments.src: - **Risiko tata kelola**: keputusan yang dipengaruhi kepentingan non-komersial tanpa kajian yang memadai.
segments.tr: - **Governance risk**: decisions influenced by non-commercial interests without adequate study.

segments.src: - **Risiko likuiditas**: aset sulit dicairkan saat diperlukan.
segments.tr: - **Liquidity risk**: assets are difficult to liquidate when needed.

segments.src: - **Risiko utang dan jaminan**: kewajiban yang akhirnya ditanggung anggaran negara.
segments.tr: - **Debt and guarantee risk**: obligations that are ultimately borne by the state budget.

segments.src: - **Risiko pasar dan nilai tukar**: terutama untuk investasi lintas negara.
segments.tr: - **Market and exchange rate risk**: especially for cross-border investments.

segments.src: - **Risiko reputasi**: dampak pada kepercayaan investor dan peringkat kredit negara.
segments.tr: - **Reputational risk**: impact on investor confidence and the country's credit rating.

segments.src: Risiko bukan berarti larangan berinvestasi.
segments.tr: Risk does not mean a ban on investing.

segments.src: Lembaga yang sehat akan menjelaskan risikonya secara terbuka dan menyiapkan mitigasinya.
segments.tr: A healthy agency will explain its risks openly and prepare mitigations for them.

segments.src: ## Cara praktis warga ikut mengawasi
segments.tr: ## Practical ways for citizens to participate in oversight

segments.src: 1. Baca sumber primer: undang-undang, peraturan pemerintah, dan laporan resmi.
segments.tr: 1. Read primary sources: laws, government regulations, and official reports.

segments.src: 2. Bandingkan pemberitaan dari beberapa media yang berbeda sebelum menyimpulkan.
segments.tr: 2. Compare news coverage from several different media outlets before drawing conclusions.

segments.src: 3. Ikuti kajian lembaga riset, akademisi, dan organisasi masyarakat sipil yang menerbitkan data terbuka.
segments.tr: 3. Follow studies by research institutions, academics, and civil society organizations that publish open data.

segments.src: 4. Gunakan hak atas informasi publik dengan mengajukan permohonan resmi bila data belum tersedia.
segments.tr: 4. Use the right to public information by submitting an official request if data is not yet available.

segments.src: 5. Sampaikan masukan melalui wakil rakyat atau kanal pengaduan resmi.
segments.tr: 5. Provide input through people's representatives or official complaint channels.

segments.src: 6. Waspadai klaim yang terlalu pasti, baik yang sangat memuji maupun yang sangat menyerang, tanpa data pendukung.
segments.tr: 6. Be wary of claims that are too certain, both those that are highly praising and those that are highly attacking, without supporting data.

segments.src: ## Penutup
segments.tr: ## Closing

segments.src: Danantara memiliki potensi sekaligus tantangan.
segments.tr: Danantara has both potential and challenges.

segments.src: Potensinya ada pada pembiayaan pembangunan yang lebih terarah.
segments.tr: Its potential lies in more targeted development financing.

segments.src: Tantangannya ada pada akuntabilitas, pengelolaan risiko, dan keterbukaan informasi.
segments.tr: Its challenges lie in accountability, risk management, and information transparency.

segments.src: Bagi warga, ukuran terbaik bukan slogan, melainkan bukti: laporan yang terbuka, audit yang kredibel, pengawasan yang berfungsi, dan hasil yang dapat diperiksa.
segments.tr: For citizens, the best measure is not slogans, but evidence: open reports, credible audits, functioning oversight, and verifiable results.

segments.src: Dengan kebiasaan membaca data dan bertanya secara kritis, publik membantu memastikan dana negara dikelola untuk kepentingan bersama.
segments.tr: By getting into the habit of reading data and asking critical questions, the public helps ensure that state funds are managed for the common good.
